purpose: Coordination contract for the OPT-IN consumer phase of the qa/restore disposable restore rehearsal. Storage-restore ownership: qa/restore (this repo). Runner ownership: backend-consumer.py = backendagent; chat/scripts/restore-consumer.mjs = chatagent. Gate semantics are never weakened to fit a candidate after a failure; schema/interface alignments to ACTUAL deliveries are recorded as decisions here.

schema_alignment_decision_2026_10_01.decision: consumer gate re-aligned from the earlier guessed surface (chat.upstream.baseUrl, check names proxy/collection/file_content) to the ACTUAL delivered chat receipt shape; the two exact real-observation check ids are the only required ids; reportOnly checks stay advisory except when carrying a required id (then fail); networkTripwire.blockedAttempts is an ARRAY and must be length 0 (integer 0 rejected as wrong type); failure gate strictness preserved or increased, never lowered.

engine_preflight.added: preflight runs `docker info` (stdout+stderr captured to logs/engine-info.txt, no credentials involved) BEFORE image inspection and records the selected docker CLI path; an engine failure dies ENGINE-BLOCKED (never misclassified as image-not-present) and touches no resources; image inspection failure is classified separately as IMAGE-BLOCKED
engine_preflight.motivation: shared podman pause/resource errors made the old image-inspect-only preflight misreport an engine outage as a missing image; run restored-consumers-20261001-a failed preflight this way and is retained unchanged as failure evidence
engine_preflight.infrastructure_pending: lead provisions a private podman root + wrapper PATH via the infra agent so toolchain identities record the selected CLI path / engine root from docker info; qa/restore must not migrate, reset or prune unknown/shared resources

writer_hold: qa/restore/** and runner scripts must not be edited while any rehearsal run is active anywhere: provenance hashes oracle.py/rehearsal.sh/runner scripts/production-source manifest at stage start and re-verifies at finalize; a mid-run edit fails the run's provenance (this exact failure hit run crr3-final-201857 on 2026-10-01 — failure evidence preserved, no pass claimed). Coordinate run windows through the lead.

optional: --chat-consumer <path> (default ../cortex-chat/scripts/restore-consumer.mjs; passed to the backend runner as its --chat-consumer hook path)

--chat-app-node <path> (or env CORTEX_CHAT_APP_NODE): node binary for the chat app process, if provided; resolved to a realpath, must exist+executable (else preflight BLOCK), hashed in provenance, version-recorded unconditionally (no presumed runtime cause attached to set/unset) and passed to the backend runner as --chat-app-node for forwarding as the chat runner's --app-node; unset = recorded as unset, no cause assumed
harness_cli.when: consumer-journeys stage runs AFTER the healthy-restore oracle PASS and BEFORE the destructive incomplete control; failures fail closed and preserve healthy restored evidence
harness_cli.isolation: consumer phase runs ONLY against a graph COPY (target neo4j data volume copied offline while the target is stopped; consumer container crr-<id>-neo4j-cons with bolt on a second random loopback port) + file-root copies at <workspace>/consumer-files/. Frozen-state hashes of the COPY (graph capture + per-root file manifests) are collected BEFORE any consumer write; after the consumer boot the ORIGINAL target graph and restored volumes are re-captured and must be byte-identical (isolation proof; breach = stage failure).
harness_cli.interpreter: backend runner invoked with CORTEX_CONSUMER_PYTHON env if set, else /tmp/opencode/qa-venv/bin/python if present, else system python3; interpreter path + version + per-module dep identity recorded in <workspace>/consumer-results/interpreter.json. Missing deps are an environment block (runner exits 2 by design), never a product failure and never mocked. Installed: /tmp/opencode/qa-venv (python 3.13.5; fastapi 0.142.2, uvicorn 0.54.0, neo4j 6.3.1, httpx 0.28.1).

consumer_gate.overall_result_mode: HTTP journeys only: no browser automation, no model/provider calls, no DNS-discovery claim in direct-ip transport; consumer journeys run against the isolated backend URL over the published loopback
consumer_gate.acceptance_rule: exit 0 + strict receipt validation; a reportOnly check carrying a required id fails; a check with a legacy (gate-v1) id fails wherever it appears; mismatch/missing chat_execution metadata is no green; missing/false JSON fields are failures, never greens; the gate is not updated after a failure to merely fit a candidate
consumer_gate.post_gate_isolation_proof: after the runner exits, the harness re-captures the ORIGINAL target graph and all five ORIGINAL restored file roots and requires byte-identical equality with the pre-consumer captures; file isolation uses oracle.py isolation-compare against the ACTUAL EVID locator (original-files-after-consumers-<root>.json; run I failed on a WS-path locator mismatch — FileNotFoundError, not a measured mutation); missing/unreadable/malformed manifests classify GATE-ARTIFACT-MISSING / GATE-ARTIFACT-INVALID (cannot measure), real diffs still fail as ISOLATION-BREACH; all roots/bytes/dirs required

transport_adapter.reason: private podman 5.4.2 root provisioned by infra works with the default bridge and Neo4j, but user-defined named networks fail aardvark-DNS startup (systemd user bus unavailable); shared engine is never migrated/reset and real service configs are untouched
transport_adapter.network_binding_decoder: environmental decoder only (oracle.py network-binding): decodes the subnet from the ACTUAL docker network inspect payload of the run-owned network — Docker shape (Name/Id + IPAM.Config[].Subnet) and Podman shape (name/id + subnets[].subnet, observed on podman 5.4.2 where the .IPAM.Config template is unsupported) both supported; fails closed on orphan/name-mismatch, duplicate entries, missing Id, unknown driver shape, ambiguous subnets, invalid CIDR, non-private subnets and malformed JSON; no guessed fallbacks; both shapes agreeing recorded as 'docker-ipam+podman-subnets-agree'; run d failed here ('subnet inspect failed') because the Docker-only template hit the Podman schema — fixed before any pass claim
transport_adapter.cli_call_protocol: helpers accept the raw JSON via explicit flag (override) OR piped on stdin (how the harness pipes inspect output at every call site incl. refresh); empty/malformed stdin fails nonzero, no fallback; argparse flags no longer 'required' so the harness pipe cannot die with 'required --network-json missing' (run e failure); hermetic selftest includes real subprocess CLI tests with the exact harness argv for both Docker and Podman payloads plus negative exits (wrong id, out-of-subnet, orphan, malformed/empty stdin)
transport_adapter.mechanism: docker network create --disable-dns (podman-supported); source/target store INTERNAL IPs inspected from the run-owned network after start and validated (network id match + IP in decoded subnet, oracle.py transport-endpoint + hermetic selftest); backup.sh/restore.sh receive NEO4J_ADDRESS=bolt://<inspected-ip>:7687 via SOURCE_ADDRESS/TARGET_ADDRESS built fresh per stage and logged in every receipt; consumer bolt stays on the published 127.0.0.1 loopback; consumer graph copy joins the same private network; cypher-shell exec inside containers unchanged; no external providers
transport_adapter.unchanged: default (no flag) keeps name-based DNS; actual Neo4j/APOC/HTTP consumers unchanged; no checker assertion lowered; no production config/script changes
transport_adapter.claim_limit: direct-ip mode exercises no DNS-based service discovery and records none as evidence; engine that rejects --disable-dns dies TRANSPORT-BLOCKED (no silent fallback)
transport_adapter.captured: mode in provenance.json harness_meta; chosen endpoints in stage receipts, summary.json transport block, evidence/transport.json
transport_adapter.endpoint_refresh: container name/id is the stable identity, the internal IP is ephemeral (rootless podman may reassign across stop/start; a stale target IP could address the consumer-copy store): the harness re-inspects + re-validates the source endpoint before the snapshot and the target endpoint immediately after the consumer-phase restart and before each destructive restore (healthy/incomplete/refusals) with the same oracle transport validation; each resolved endpoint + container id is recorded in the stage receipts and logs/transport-refresh.log; no new gate assertions — the existing allowed-transport constraint enforced at the claimed operation; comparison oracles unchanged
